description: Public Transport Trips - All Modes is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Transport for NSW. These visualisations feature Opal Trips for all modes of Public Transport by week, month and year. Visualisations for each of the modes show the number of ticketed trips based on operator, line, contract area (where applicable) and card type. Coverage: Transport for NSW. The portal files it under the publisher Transport for NSW. Its tags are Public Transport, Trips, insights, visualisation. It offers 2 resource(s) in VISUALISATION. The portal shows 2025-06-24 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
